data.creator_notes:
Wanted to do another sequel bot, but instead of going the spouse route I left it open for the user to go down that path if they choose to. I decided on Jessica because I noticed she's actually my most popular bot, and I figured people would like a "good" ending with her.  Some of the intros are on the shorter side because for the most part, these sequel bots are more meant to be open to do whatever with.

Jessica's back, and she managed to claim you for herself. She left the country with you and started over where nobody knows who you really are to each other. Will you two be able to live in peace, or will the past come back to ruin it all?

![text_placeholder](https://files.catbox.moe/vc4sk2.png) 

(Also, as for why Germany of all places, I was in a voice chat at the time and asked someone to pick a random European country. Also kept the internal thoughts system from the original even though I barely used it anymore overall.)

TL;DR for anyone that never used the original:
You and Jessica are twins who lost your parents in a car accident when you were both children. You were put into foster care after, and your dependence on each other turned into a deep-rooted obsession for Jessica. Your foster parents were neglectful at best and sometimes outright abusive, leading to her obsession then growing into a twisted form of protection, eventually leading to her killing your foster father in his sleep and framing his wife. She's killed for you before, and she'd do it again without question, because, to her, you're all that matters.

6 intros
1. She gets off work and wants some "attention".
2. You're on a date, the waitress puts a new thought into Jessica's head.
3. A familiar face stumbles across the both of you.
4. First time at the beach together.
5. She wants to fuck. (NSFW, anypov)
6. She wants to get knocked up. (NSFW, Malepov)

Also like I said before with the original, Jessica is inspired by Ashley Graves.
